fixtures.name: Normal observations
fixtures.code:
# R translation of a Stan program, generated by Stan2R (pointwise posterior predictive densities).
# Reads data from the list `dat`; every top-level Stan variable is returned in `out`.

# helper functions
# accumulate pointwise log densities; NA marks elements without a term yet
add_log_density <- function(current, term) ifelse(is.na(current), 0, current) + term

#~~~~~~~~~~~~#
#### data ####
#~~~~~~~~~~~~#

N <- dat$N
y <- dat$y

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~#
#### parameters ####
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~#

mu <- 0.6
sigma <- 0.9

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~#
#### model ####
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~#

log_density__ <- list()
log_density__$y <- y
log_density__$y[] <- NA_real_
# (prior, fixed by the posterior draw: mu ~ normal(0, 2);)
# (prior, fixed by the posterior draw: sigma ~ normal(0, 1);)
log_density__$y <- add_log_density(log_density__$y, dnorm(y, mu, sigma, log = TRUE))

#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~#
#### output ####
#~~~~~~~~~~~~~~#

# observed data are replaced by their pointwise densities (masses)
out <- list(N = N, y = exp(log_density__$y), mu = mu, sigma = sigma)
